name: 体験と施設と移動手段を分野別に探す五列一覧
prompt:
Create one wide five-column Japanese travel-category mega menu on a clean white canvas, close to the supplied 1548:880 source crop proportions.

Reference priority:
1) The original cropped menu controls the five-column widths, vertical separators, heading icons, item order, row spacing, and which rows have chevrons or muted subcategories.
2) The Japanese preview controls the exact Japanese headings, labels, green accent, and the standalone panel boundary. Use only the white menu panel; omit the surrounding website header and the background carousel imagery visible beyond the panel in the full source screenshot.

Build five columns with thin pale-gray vertical dividers and compact, readable Japanese rows. Use one small outlined green category icon at each heading: paper-plane for tours, star/ticket for attractions, house for lodging, bus for transport, and a green plus for more. Use dark near-black primary labels, gray secondary routes, and small dark-gray right chevrons only where shown in the source.

Column 1 heading “ツアーと体験”: “ツアー”, “クルーズ”, “マッサージと温泉”, “水のアクティビティ”, “屋外とスポーツ”, “文化体験”.
Column 2 heading “施設のチケット”: “テーマパーク”, “ウォーターパーク”, “美術館と博物館”, “公園と庭園”, “動物園と水族館”, “ロープウェイ”, “史跡”, “遊び場”, “屋内の遊び”, “周遊パス”, “イベントと公演”.
Column 3 heading “宿泊先”: “ホテル”.
Column 4 heading “移動手段”: “鉄道のチケット”, muted subitems “日本の鉄道” and “ヨーロッパの鉄道”, then “日本の鉄道パス”, “ヨーロッパの鉄道パス”, “都市圏のバスとカード”, “空港送迎”, “空港鉄道とバス”, “航空券”, “フェリー”, “バス”, muted subitems “台湾の都市間バス” and “国際バス”, then “レンタカー” and “貸切車両”.
Column 5 heading “さらに探す” with a plus icon: “食事”, “買い物”, “通信とカード”, “旅行サービス”, “保険”.

Use a restrained Japanese sans-serif like Meiryo, consistent text size and baseline, bold but compact column headings, and the preview's #2D8F5E green icon accents. Preserve the source density and generous white panel.

Do not add website navigation, background photos, cards, shadows, buttons, decorative artwork, extra rows, extra labels, or watermark. Keep all five columns visible and do not clip or abbreviate Japanese copy.
reviewNotes: Five-column Japanese travel mega menu; visually reviewed for label fidelity, column order, legibility and clipping.
